query:
SELECT CAST(message_id AS BLOB) AS "message_id!: Vec<u8>", created_at, updated_at,
                    CAST(expires_at AS INTEGER) AS "expires_at?: i64",
                    CAST(message_json AS BLOB) AS "message_json?: Vec<u8>",
                    (message_json IS NOT NULL) AS "has_message!: bool",
                    CAST(delivery_state_json AS BLOB) AS "delivery_state_json!: Vec<u8>",
                    (typeof(message_id) = 'text') AS "key_is_text!: bool",
                    CASE WHEN typeof(created_at) <> 'integer' THEN 1
                         WHEN typeof(updated_at) <> 'integer' THEN 2
                         WHEN typeof(expires_at) NOT IN ('integer', 'null') THEN 3
                         ELSE 0 END AS "integer_fault!: i64"
             FROM inbox_messages WHERE CASE WHEN json_valid(delivery_state_json) THEN
                    json_extract(delivery_state_json, '$.family') IS NOT 'system' AND
                    CASE WHEN json_extract(delivery_state_json, '$.handoff.kind') = 'direct' THEN
                        COALESCE(json_extract(delivery_state_json, '$.handoff.state.kind')
                            NOT IN ('writing', 'notKnown', 'notSeen', 'seen'), 1)
                    ELSE COALESCE(json_extract(delivery_state_json, '$.handoff.kind')
                            NOT IN ('completed', 'notRequired'), 1) END
                    ELSE 1 END
                 AND CASE WHEN json_valid(message_json) THEN
                    json_extract(message_json, '$.body.delivery') IS NOT 'queue' AND
                    json_extract(message_json, '$.body.delivery') IS NOT 'steer'
                    ELSE 1 END
                 ORDER BY created_at, message_id
